title: Dispute Holds on Northgate Card Credit Balance Refunds
content:
A credit balance on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account that rests on dispute credits is partly held when the cardholder asks for a refund. The dispute hold follows the disputes on the account:

- where a dispute stands open, the disputed amounts opened exceeding the amounts that have left dispute status, and a provisional dispute credit has posted on the account, the amount still under dispute is held;
- where no dispute stands open, the hold is the provisional dispute credits posted less those already re-billed and less the amounts of disputes resolved for the cardholder, never less than zero;
- in every other case nothing is held.

**Terms.** The disputed amounts opened are the amounts of every dispute opened on the account; the amounts that have left dispute status are the amounts of every resolution or withdrawal entry; the amount still under dispute is the first less the second. Re-billed provisional credits are the provisional dispute credits reversed after a dispute went for the merchant. The amounts of disputes resolved for the cardholder are the amounts that left dispute status with the outcome resolved for the cardholder.

| Dispute standing open | Provisional dispute credit posted on the account | Dispute hold |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the amount still under dispute |
| yes | no | nothing |
| no | any | provisional credits posted less re-billed less resolved for the cardholder, never less than zero |

**Hypothetical cases.** Disputes opened for 260.00, 60.00 of which has left dispute status, with a provisional credit posted: 200.00 is held. No dispute open; provisional credits of 260.00 posted, 60.00 re-billed and 150.00 resolved for the cardholder: 50.00 is held. No dispute open; a provisional credit of 75.00 later resolved for the cardholder for 75.00: nothing is held.
